svg.title: Double-well Lagrangian
svg.desc: Left: a one-weight loss with a wide shallow basin and a narrow deep basin, with the global beta-minimisers on each side of the jump. Right: the structure function, its convex hull, and the band of complexities that no beta selects.
svg.text: A double well: the β-minimiser jumps, and annealing misses the jump
One weight; P = N(0, 3²); Q = N(µ, σ²); N = 50. Left: the per-sample loss. Right: the structure function.
A line of slope −β touches the hull; at β_c it touches two points at once, and the optimum jumps across the red band.
Annealing from large β with ε-local steps stays in the wide basin unless ε covers the whole jump.
